blocks.text:
To discover what item, if any, the user has selected from the `DropDown`,
call DropDown::get_selected(). This returns an
`unsigned int` that you can use to get the selected data from the model.
For instance, you might read an integer ID value from the model, even though you
have chosen only to show the human-readable description in the
`DropDown`. For instance:
